_about.what: TRIAL (far-side seats rig, never for main). Placeholder rows so that every owner code on the final chart is a country and every one of the fourteen far-side seats can be opened before its seats file exists. Same layout as a seats file (tools/trial/seats.mjs). A seats file that brings a code (a nation row, a door entry or a corps row for it) takes this file's rows for that code away.
_about.state: NOT THE RECORD AND NOT TO BE LIFTED: every figure here is a stand-in (quality 0.5, no air force, one half-strength garrison in the capital, no tie, no war). Japan is not a seat: its row exists only because the chart has Japanese ground.
